ir.name: loss_pairwise_rank_weighted_sigmoid_regret_normalized
ir.intuition: Injects an explicit normalization constraint by dividing the weighted sum of the loss by the sum of weights plus epsilon, ensuring stability and scale invariance in pairwise loss aggregation.
ir.pseudocode:
delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
weight = batch['weight']
margin = lpw - lpl
regret_weight = sigmoid(beta * delta_regret)
smooth_margin = tanh(alpha * margin)
loss_raw = -logsigmoid(smooth_margin * regret_weight)
weighted_loss = loss_raw * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / (sum(weight) + epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    regret_weight = ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(beta, delta_regret))
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(ops.mul(alpha, margin))
    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(ops.mul(smooth_margin, regret_weight)))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)
    denom = ops.add(ops.sum(weight), 1e-8)
    normalized_loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), denom)
    return normalized_loss
